# Documentation Rules

- Paths and commands must match the current repository.
- Distinguish live root-repo behavior from package templates and worked examples.
- Prefer concise, copy-paste-safe instructions.
- Update stale references in the same change when behavior or paths move.
- Mark optional steps and machine-specific assumptions clearly.
